title: Relative-today prefix
description: Prepends an inked "Hoy · " before the abbreviated date — "Hoy · Dom 23 ago" — giving riders an immediate relative anchor (today) ahead of the absolute date, useful on a kiosk that's always displaying "now".

changes.intent: Compute a relative-day prefix ('Hoy') and combine it with the abbreviated date string.
changes.detail: Add a computed relativePrefix that is always 'Hoy' for the kiosk's local today (the composable has no notion of other days, so this is a static label rather than a diffed date, ready to extend to 'Mañana' if the board ever shows forecasted dates). Combine as `${relativePrefix} · ${formattedAbbrevDate}` using the same short weekday/month formatting as date-abbrev ('Dom 23 ago'), producing 'Hoy · Dom 23 ago'.

changes.intent: Wrap the 'Hoy' prefix in its own span so it can be styled with more visual weight than the rest of the date.
Make the relative cue read as inked/emphasized against the otherwise muted date line.
